title: This Mars Rover Just Broke an Out-of-This-World Driving Record
description:
On October 11, 2026, NASA's Perseverance rover reached 45.22 km (28.10 miles), passing Opportunity's record for the farthest drive on another world.
It got there in about 5.5 years versus Opportunity's nearly 15, thanks to AutoNav self-driving that handled more than 90% of the distance.
